rows.definition: Package eveparity (internal/eveparity) is the CI-runnable witness for issue #2605: it runs a fixture Eve-shaped eval suite once raw and once fak-routed through the real gateway proxy, then Compare folds the two arms into a Witness proving fak never silently downgrades a hard Eve gate failure into a soft pass.
rows.distinction: It is the FAK-MEDIATION eval-agreement witness (raw arm vs fak-routed arm over one eval suite), not a model-quality parity grader (qwen36parity).

rows.definition: The closed arm-time refusal token (ReasonMonitorNoFailureCoverage, abi.ReasonCode 1044, internal/toolproc/monitor.go) ArmMonitor cites when a monitor's filter declares no failure-signature class alongside its progress pattern, so a monitor that would stay silent-on-failure by construction is refused instead of armed.
rows.distinction: It is a MONITOR ARM-TIME refusal reason over failure-signature filter coverage, not a tools-module test-file audit (toolcoverage) nor the generic coverage concept (coverage) nor a dispatch-fetch coverage metric (RouterCoverage).

rows.definition: The eveparity.Witness.ParityVerdict string field ('pass' | 'divergent') Compare sets: pass only when every case agrees on pass/fail with a byte-identical reason and no hard-gate failure was downgraded to a soft score; any disagreement or downgrade flips it to divergent.
rows.distinction: It is the eve-vs-fak-routed EVAL-AGREEMENT top-line verdict field on one Witness, not the multi-replica memory-agreement enum (ParityVerdict recall) nor a local-vs-frontier model scorecard verdict.

rows.definition: The recall package's uint8 enum (ParityAgree | ParityResolved | ParityConflict) ParityFinding.Verdict carries: whether several replicas of one logical memory resource corroborate on bytes, resolve to one clear live witness, or conflict with no clear winner (#786).
rows.distinction: It is the MULTI-REPLICA memory disagreement verdict recall's ParityFinding carries, a completely separate Go type from the eveparity Witness's pass/divergent field despite sharing the identifier ParityVerdict.

rows.definition: CosineParity is the cosine similarity between a candidate arm's output and its reference arm's output: the Strix ablation receipt records it per ablation row (internal/amdgpu/strix_receipt.go:739), the Strix candidate verdict marks a run REGRESSED when it is NaN or below the configured minimum (internal/amdgpu/strix_candidate.go), and the Qwen3.8 subagent packet requires it at or above MinCosineParity 0.9999 (internal/cachevalue/qwen38_subagent_packet.go).
rows.distinction: A measured similarity score, not a pass/fail parity verdict by itself: a gate turns it into PROMOTED or REGRESSED only against an explicit minimum, and it is not the qualitative `parity` concept.

rows.definition: agent.ErrWarmPrefixUnsupported (internal/agent/inkernel_warm.go:66) is the fail-closed sentinel WarmPrefix returns when a planner cannot materialize or restore a native prefix cache: a nil planner, an unbounded descriptor, no prefix tree, a recompute-only model or backend, or a V4.1 route without complete-snapshot continuation, each with its own closed receipt reason. The turnkey startup warm tests for it with errors.Is (cmd/fak/up_agent_warm.go:314) and reports the warm as unsupported rather than degraded.
rows.distinction: It means this planner cannot warm at all; a cancelled context or a device fault returns a cold receipt with a different error. It is not `kvprefixreusesupported`, the per-architecture predicate on whether a KV cache is the complete session prefix, which is only one of the gates behind this refusal.
